22:30 │ A CONTINUACIÓN: College Football
The No. 15 Red Raiders host the Mountaineers at Galaxy Stadium for a Big 12 matchup. West Virginia seeks to make it three straight after a 24-20 win over TCU, while Texas Tech beat Arizona 34-26 and has dropped only one game this season.
